changelog:
CSM 1.0.873

Appearance and motion: preserve saved gradients at startup, re-enable recycled-card scroll animations, match language badges on complete tokens, and compact each padding edge independently.
Player: keep zoom video-only and in the CSM store, retire stale controls, retain pending watched thresholds during visual refresh, cancel next-episode countdowns after rewind or pause, and prefer actual video metadata over display dimensions. Restore only still-owned native focus links when injected controls leave.
Content and downloads: filter only verified native catalog cards, bind external-download controls to their exact player, and recheck current download rules immediately before every handoff.
Discord: respect title-off defaults across presence transports, prevent episode changes from mixing progress timelines, preserve authored hover text, and retire profile/cache callbacks with their owning account.
Settings sharing: validate complete reviewed value types before one checked import commit, include all selected category settings and notification controls, preserve private/local state, and cancel retired Wi-Fi sender operations and sockets.
System and search: keep successful automatic-update completion alive, require explicit master enablement for cache cleanup, honor modern exit choices, reset and recover both Discord button text/URL pairs with checked save results, and keep mode-dependent search actions aligned with their owning settings page.

Static/source and off-device regression verification do not certify decoded playback, Discord-client rendering, physical phone/TV navigation, host next-episode dispatch, or real LAN device transfers. Unsupported features remain unsupported.
message: CSM Dev v873 - full-feature audit and lifecycle repairs
